header: How would you rather set the first till up?
subheader: The programme and the price are the same on all three routes.
lead: The only difference is who does the article list and who stands behind the counter on the first busy morning.
note: € 39 per till and month on every route. Setting up with us costs nothing extra; a dealer bills their own work.

paths.title: Set it up yourself
paths.description: You enter articles and prices, we look over the first cashing-up. Sensible for one branch with one or two tills.

paths.title: Go through it with us
paths.description: One appointment, your article list imported, and somebody on the phone on the first Saturday. From three tills, or wherever scales are involved.

paths.title: Through your own dealer
paths.description: Somebody already looks after your hardware? We work with 40 dealers in Austria and southern Germany, and they keep the relationship.
